description: Entergy is an integrated energy company engaged primarily in electric power production and energy delivery to retail customers. It owns and operates power plants with approximately 25,000 MW of electric generating capacity, delivers electricity to approximately 3.1 million Utility customers in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas, had annual revenues of $12.9 billion in 2025 and had approximately 12,000 employees as of December 31, 2025. Its strategy is to operate and grow its utility business designed to understand and meet customer needs, creating value for all of its key stakeholders, including customers, communities, employees and owners, and it invests significant capital to support customer growth as well as reliability and resilience and is also investing in clean energy.
